runs.display_title: fix(release): purge restored workspace bytecode in the release test job (BUG-0065 root cause)

head_commit.message:
fix(release): purge restored workspace bytecode in the release test job (BUG-0065 root cause)

Root cause of the three identical release-lane failures (cohort-report
[ASSERTION_FAILURE] 122/5, verdicts collapsed to 'unverified'): the
release test job runs in the prepared-env RESTORE lane, which skips
setup-racket's stale-bytecode purge. Restored .zo snapshots carry mtimes
NEWER than the fresh checkout, so Racket executes the producer's
bytecode instead of the checked-out sources. Proven by the executed
suite name in the CI artifact: 'final-claim verdict cohort (c3,
v1.00.27 w5)' — lowercase — a W5-development-era source that does not
exist in the tagged tree (the tag's file reads uppercase '(C3, ... W5)').

- release.yml test job: purge all workspace .zo/compiled before the
  fast suite (preserving the frozen metadata-discovery fixture), so the
  lane tests exactly what it checked out
- test-ci-cohort-report.rkt: permanent BUG-0065 diagnostic dump — the
  fully-guarded gate state lands in per-file output on every run
- workflow-contract tests pin the purge step and the diagnostics

Local reproduction matched the mechanism exactly: editing the test
(recompile) over a stale module .zo reproduced the 5 failures;
purging fixed it (25/25).

runs.display_title: fix: dispatch symbol ev-keys to string-keyed TUI reducers (BUG-0062)

head_commit.message:
fix: dispatch symbol ev-keys to string-keyed TUI reducers (BUG-0062)

Live GSD emitters publish symbol event names (emit-gsd-event!
'gsd.verification.started) while the reducer registry is keyed by
strings — apply-event-to-state silently dropped every gsd.* event at
dispatch. This made the coordinator-owned verification lane invisible
despite BUG-0058's events/reducers being correct and fully tested:
tests construct string-ev events, matching the registry, while the
only live producer uses symbols.

- normalize symbol ev-keys to strings in apply-event-to-state; the
  fix restores the whole gsd.* event family live (verification
  started/completed/escalated, wave.outcome-error, plan.archived,
  campaign.infra-retry/notified)
- approved verification now leaves a durable transcript line with
  elapsed time and log path instead of clearing the status bar
  silently (truthful final state, BUG-0058 follow-through)
- regression tests construct the exact live shape (symbol ev +
  GSD-wrapped payload); previous string-shape tests kept unchanged

Fast suite: 1173/1173 files pass (isolated HOME).
